sonnet.problem: Story card 3 calls the new well 'a well of fresh water', which gives away the answer 'water' to the fill-in-the-blank on the next choice card, where the herdsmen say the ___ is theirs.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The question says Nobody quarrels over the next well 'so he names it Rehoboth'. Verse 22 only says he named it Rehoboth and gives no reason, so 'so' adds a cause the text doesn't state.
sonnet.rule: He never adds why someone did, said or thought something unless the text says why.
